document.title: Terrorism: Usama Bin Ladin's Activities in Somalia and Sudanese NIF Support
document.publisher: National Security Archive (GWU), The Central Intelligence Agency 9/11 File: Hundreds of Secret Agency Documents on Osama Bin Laden Declassified
document.note: CIA Intelligence Report on bin Ladin's activities in Somalia and Sudanese NIF support. Source: 9/11 Commission Report, Chapter 2, Endnote 45; Chapter 4, Endnote 3.

persons.name: Usama bin Ladin
persons.role: Subject of the report; linked to activities in Somalia and to support from Sudan's NIF

mentions.quote: TERRORISM: OSAMA BIN LADIN'S ACTIVITIES IN SOMALIA AND SUDANESE NIF SUPPORT

organizations.name: Islamic Army
organizations.notes: The text says its members were sent to Somalia, with NIF knowledge and encouragement, to kill U.S. troops. The document is heavily redacted and the OCR is garbled, so the group's exact link to bin Ladin is unclear.

organizations.name: National Islamic Front (NIF)
organizations.notes: Sudan's ruling Islamist movement. The report says it knew of and encouraged Islamic Army deployments to Somalia.

organizations.name: Central Intelligence Agency
organizations.notes: Originator of the information report, which was distributed on 30 April 1997 to many US agencies.

organizations.name: United States
organizations.notes: Its troops and personnel were the targets of Islamic Army activity in Somalia.

places.name: Somalia
places.significance: Where Islamic Army members were sent to fight US forces and undermine the US mission.

places.name: Sudan
places.significance: Base of the NIF, which supported the Islamic Army's travel to Somalia.

events.description: CIA information report on bin Ladin's activities in Somalia and NIF support, distributed to US agencies
Islamic Army members were sent to Somalia, with the NIF's knowledge and encouragement, to kill US troops, incite violence against US personnel and undermine the US mission.

key_claims: Islamic Army members were sent to Somalia to kill US troops and undermine the US mission.
The Sudanese NIF knew of and encouraged the Islamic Army deployment to Somalia.
The report links Usama bin Ladin to the Islamic Army and to NIF support, though the text is heavily redacted.
